newsitem.title: CHINA: China says wife-beating imported from West.
newsitem.headline: China says wife-beating imported from West.

text.p: Western influences and the evils of capitalism are to blame for a rise in wife and child beating in China, the Comprehensive Weekly said.

The All-China Women's Federation had received 30,000 letters reporting incidents of family violence in 1995, more than 30 times the number received the previous year, the newspaper said in an edition seen in Beijing on Saturday.
Market-oriented reforms had allowed many Western social evils to take hold in China, the newspaper said.
"How to keep the morally corrupt aspects of Western society outside our nation's doors is something that deserves the profound attention of the Chinese people," it said.
China has seen a marked rise in social problems ranging from violent crime to prostitution along with the rapid rise in living standards brought about by economic reform.
These problems have led to a backlash against Western ideas and culture.
